How It Works

From voice note to
booked job in 60 seconds

Three steps. No typing. No forgetting. Just speak and it's done.

1

Capture the job

"Sarah Johnson called. AC repair at 142 Oak Street this Thursday morning. Entrance pin is 1234."

Just say it. On the road, on site, between jobs — whenever the call comes in. No need to stop and type.

Fast enough to use while the details are still fresh
2

Details extracted automatically

Memory listens to your voice note and pulls out everything that matters: client name, location, date, time window, job type, and access notes.

No manual data entry. No copy-pasting from texts. It just appears, structured and ready.

The original voice note stays attached for context
3

Job on the calendar

One tap and the visit is scheduled, visible to your whole team, and connected to the original note. Nothing sits in limbo waiting to be remembered later.

The next action is clear the moment the note is finished
